facts.business: Aadhar Housing Finance Limited is a leading housing finance company dedicated to enabling homeownership for low-income populations in India, managing an AUM of ₹306 billion with a 100% secured retail loan book.
key_risks: Global volatility and shifting interest rates
Impairment of loans (expected credit losses) involving significant judgement and estimates
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties are in compliance with sections 177 and 188 of the Act where applicable and details have been disclosed in the notes to the standalone financial statements as required by applicable accounting standards.
